name: correctness
title: Correctness or extraction
summary: Count the expected cases whose output satisfies an independent oracle. Guards keep coverage, types, genuinely zero answers and error paths honest.
goal: Increase the number of expected cases whose output matches the independent oracle without losing coverage, types, zero answers or error paths.
targetGuidance: Set the bar one or two cases above the measured baseline. Do not shrink the case set or relax the oracle to reach it.

guardDetails.coverage: Every manifest case appears exactly once and every required tag has a case.
guardDetails.types: Every output leaf has the oracle's JSON type; a string zero is not a numeric zero.
guardDetails.zero: Genuinely zero or empty answers are present and correct.
guardDetails.error_paths: Every expected error case is present and returns the expected error.

data.label: SAMPLE FIXTURE — replace with real project cases and expected outputs
data.resultFormat: JSONL or a JSON array; one row per case with case and output or error.

knownBad.reason: One subtotal is wrong, so the score falls below the baseline.
A zero subtotal is returned as the string '0'; the types guard rejects it.
One manifest case is absent, so the score is not trustworthy.
A case appears twice, so the count would be inflated.
A non-finite number cannot be compared to the oracle.
A row has neither output nor error.

repeats.why: The adapter is deterministic; repeated fixture runs must return the same score.

notes: The oracle is the manifest's expected value. The candidate never grades itself. A real case set should include at least one zero answer and one error path.
